ciBytes:
name: CI

on:
  workflow_call: {}
  pull_request:
  merge_group:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  # A shared ref also replaces pending main runs, even with cancellation off.
  # Keep every non-PR SHA; only obsolete heads of the same PR share a group.
  group: check-${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event_name }}-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.sha }}
  cancel-in-progress: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' }}

jobs:
  quick:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ci-lane.yml
    with:
      script: check:ci:quick
      artifact: quick
      revision: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

  foundation:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ci-lane.yml
    with:
      script: check:ci:foundation
      artifact: foundation
      revision: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

  architecture:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ci-lane.yml
    with:
      script: check:ci:architecture
      artifact: architecture
      revision: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

  docs:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ci-lane.yml
    with:
      script: check:ci:docs
      artifact: docs
      revision: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

  product:
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ci-lane.yml
    with:
      script: check:ci:product
      artifact: product
      revision: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

  check:
    name: check
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs: [quick, foundation, architecture, docs, product]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    steps:
      - name: Checkout event revision
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          # Full history: Git-reading checks such as the SDK growth source
          # collector tests resolve retained commits on main, including the
          # original PR184 C0 transition 8e5e859d10981e1623d0617e933afc68a9e8770c.
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Verify checkout revision
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_REVISION: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_REVISION"
      - name: Setup pinned Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version
      - name: Require every full lane to succeed
        env:
          NEEDS: ${{ toJSON(needs) }}
        run: node scripts/ci/gate.ts aggregate

  postgres-durability:
    name: postgres-durability
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:18.4-trixie@sha256:a02db8cac496f15b094798a38254f14d6e00741f709360e5e00bb6668ea31636
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: contained_turn_test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d contained_turn_test"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 12
      provider-access-postgres:
        image: postgres:18.4-trixie@sha256:a02db8cac496f15b094798a38254f14d6e00741f709360e5e00bb6668ea31636
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: ar69_pa_test_ci
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
        ports:
          - 5433:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d ar69_pa_test_ci"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 12
      runtime-security-postgres:
        image: postgres:18.4-trixie@sha256:a02db8cac496f15b094798a38254f14d6e00741f709360e5e00bb6668ea31636
        env:
          POSTGRES_DB: ar69_rs_test_ci
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: postgres
          POSTGRES_USER: postgres
        ports:
          - 5434:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U postgres -d ar69_rs_test_ci"
          --health-interval 5s
          --health-timeout 5s
          --health-retries 12
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify checkout revision
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_REVISION: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_REVISION"

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version

      - name: Enable pinned pnpm
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack install --global pnpm@11.18.0

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Build PostgreSQL test target
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/agent-execution... build

      - name: Run disposable PostgreSQL durability gate
        env:
          POSTGRES_DURABILITY_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/contained_turn_test
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/agent-execution test:postgres

      - name: Build Provider Access PostgreSQL test target
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/provider-access build

      - name: Run disposable Provider Access PostgreSQL durability gate
        env:
          PA_POSTGRES_DISPOSABLE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/ar69_pa_test_ci
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/provider-access test:postgres

      - name: Create disposable Provider Access dispatch database
        env:
          PA_POSTGRES_CONTAINER: ${{ job.services.provider-access-postgres.id }}
        run: docker exec "$PA_POSTGRES_CONTAINER" createdb -U postgres ar69_pa_test_dispatchci

      - name: Run disposable Provider Access dispatch durability gate
        env:
          PA_POSTGRES_DISPOSABLE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/ar69_pa_test_dispatchci
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/provider-access test:postgres:dispatch

      - name: Create disposable Provider Access operation dispatch database
        env:
          PA_POSTGRES_CONTAINER: ${{ job.services.provider-access-postgres.id }}
        run: docker exec "$PA_POSTGRES_CONTAINER" createdb -U postgres ar69_pa_test_operationdispatchci

      - name: Run disposable Provider Access operation dispatch durability gate
        env:
          PA_POSTGRES_DISPOSABLE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/ar69_pa_test_operationdispatchci
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/provider-access test:postgres:operation-dispatch

      - name: Build Runtime Security PostgreSQL test target
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/runtime-security... build

      - name: Run disposable Runtime Security PostgreSQL durability gate
        env:
          RS_POSTGRES_DISPOSABLE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5434/ar69_rs_test_ci
        run: pnpm --filter @agent-teams/runtime-security test:postgres

      # Since AR-0 (owner decision 2026-10-02) this replaces the linux-x64 half
      # of the paired L0 receipt: the joined AE, PA and RS test on a real
      # PostgreSQL database is skipped without a disposable URL, so it must run
      # here and must not report any skipped, todo, failed or cancelled test.
      - name: Build Embedded Runtime PostgreSQL authority join target
        run: pnpm --filter "@agent-teams/embedded-runtime..." build

      - name: Create disposable Embedded Runtime authority join database
        env:
          PA_POSTGRES_CONTAINER: ${{ job.services.provider-access-postgres.id }}
        run: docker exec "$PA_POSTGRES_CONTAINER" createdb -U postgres ar69_pa_test_aejoinci

      - name: Run disposable Embedded Runtime PostgreSQL authority join gate
        shell: bash
        working-directory: packages/apps/embedded-runtime
        env:
          AE_ACL_POSTGRES_DISPOSABLE_URL: postgresql://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5433/ar69_pa_test_aejoinci
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          report="$RUNNER_TEMP/postgres-authority-join.tap"
          node --test --test-reporter=tap tests/package/postgres-authority-join.test.ts | tee "$report"
          for line in '# fail 0' '# cancelled 0' '# skipped 0' '# todo 0'; do
            grep -Fqx "$line" "$report" || { echo "::error::authority join gate incomplete: missing '$line'"; exit 1; }
          done
          grep -Eqx '# pass [1-9][0-9]*' "$report" || { echo "::error::authority join gate ran no passing test"; exit 1; }

      - name: Run disposable ordinary PostgreSQL gate
        shell: bash
        env:
          POSTGRES_SERVICE: ${{ job.services.postgres.id }}
        run: |
          export POSTGRES_TEST_IMAGE="$(docker inspect --format '{{.Config.Image}}' "$POSTGRES_SERVICE")"
          bash scripts/ci/ordinary-postgres-disposable.sh

  # Darwin coverage for every PR, merge queue run and main push. Since AR-0
  # (owner decision 2026-10-02) it replaces the darwin-arm64 half of the paired
  # L0 receipt, which ran `pnpm --filter @agent-teams/embedded-runtime check`;
  # the linux-x64 PostgreSQL half runs in postgres-durability above.
  # `pnpm product:check` cleans, builds (the same tsc project as typecheck) and
  # tests every package, embedded-runtime included. Required on main since
  # 2026-10-02.
  runtime-macos:
    name: runtime-macos
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@d23441a48e516b6c34aea4fa41551a30e30af803 # v6
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify checkout revision
        shell: bash
        env:
          EXPECTED_REVISION: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}
        run: test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "$EXPECTED_REVISION"

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with:
          node-version-file: .node-version

      - name: Enable pinned pnpm
        run: |
          corepack enable
          corepack install --global pnpm@11.18.0

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

      - name: Run macOS runtime package tests
        run: pnpm product:check
